artworks.title: ...dieron con Sancho en el suelo y lo mismo le avinó d D. Quixote...
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective with figures in the foreground and a low horizon in the background. Near the top of the image is a distant landscape with mountains. To the right, there is a horse lying on its side in rocky terrain. The style is reminiscent of classic engravings with textured brushstrokes that convey depth and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray, black, and white to create a dramatic and somber visual impact.

artworks.title: Apeáronse junto à la fuente...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene by a riverside with trees and figures. The image depicts a group of people gathered outdoors under large trees near a flowing river. One figure is seated on a rock in the foreground, extending one arm. Another person sits on the ground next to him. To the right, a group sits and stands under the trees, with a figure leaning against a tree trunk. The scene captures a moment of interaction amidst a serene, natural setting, with detailed attention to the trees, their bark, and the flowing river in the background.

artworks.title: ...y vio que à sus espaldas venian hasta seis ó siete hombres...
artworks.description: This is a drawing illustrating a scene from "Don Quixote de la Mancha." The image shows a group of people interacting with a caged figure on a cart, surrounded by various animals like donkeys and horses. In the foreground, two women stand near the wooden wheels of the cart, which carries a figure locked inside a makeshift cage made of sticks. Next to them, a man sits on a donkey, while another person carries a bundle. Figures on horseback are visible behind the cart, adding depth to the scene. In the background, hazy mountainous terrain enhances the rustic quality of the drawing. Intricate detailing, such as shading and expressions, adds a dynamic element to the narrative.

artworks.title: ...detened Señor caballero el paso...
artworks.description: This is an image featuring elaborately dressed figures in a scene set in a wooded area. The central focus is on two individuals engaged in conversation or confrontation, one in ornate clothing and the other in armor. The scene conveys a sense of historical or theatrical narrative through detailed clothing, expressions, and setting.

artworks.title: Las Bodas de Camacho
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor scene. The setting features a shaded area beneath large trees where people are engaged in various activities. In the foreground, there are objects like vases, cooking pots, and a seated figure. A carcass of a large bird is displayed on the ground. In the background, there is a group of people, some of whom are cooking or talking. The setting exudes a festive and communal atmosphere.

artworks.title: Dijolé D. Quijote: sancho amigo, la noche se nos va entrando...
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with two figures on horseback traveling across rugged terrain. The perspective is slightly above, overlooking the travelers positioned off-center to the right. In the distance, there is a softly illuminated sky suggesting either dawn or dusk. The artwork features a delicate use of line and shading with detailed brushstrokes conveying texture. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones, creating an antiquated atmosphere. The land shows rocky textures, sparse vegetation, and transitions into a middle ground with a small cluster of trees, figures, and mountains providing depth.

artworks.title: Margins for Landing in England
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and roulette in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection

artworks.title: Marine: Souvenir of Medway
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection

artworks.title: Maria Cosway with Her Daughter Louisa
artworks.medium: graphite, red and black chalk, and gray and red wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, standing with her left arm on a railing. She has delicate facial features, soft lines, and curly hair under a wide-brimmed hat with ribbons or feathers. She wears a long gown with puffy sleeves and a fitted waist, along with a necklace featuring a circular pendant. The background displays faint, unfinished sketches and intricate line work around the woman, possibly hinting at a setting or other figures. The artwork conveys grace and poise in pencil and watercolor.

artworks.title: Caring for the Ill
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a scene inside an infirmary or hospital room. It features a large bed with a person reclining on it, surrounded by other individuals. In the foreground, a small child reaches out towards the bed, and a dog stands nearby. To the right, a figure in a cloak interacts with those around them. The room has large windows, framed artworks on the walls, and the use of shading and line work creates depth and texture in the image.

artworks.title: Burying the Dead
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in various positions. One person is partially unclothed, resting on another person's lap. A third person is kneeling nearby, and a fourth person is standing holding something. The scene takes place in a cave with a rocky backdrop and outdoor scenery visible.

artworks.title: Lieutenant General Sir Colin Campbell, G.C.B.
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a seated position. He is facing slightly to his right with a neutral expression. The man has curly grayish hair, a mustache, and defined eyebrows. He is dressed in a formal uniform with a sash across his chest. His left hand rests on a bicorn hat with feathers, which he holds on his lap. The chair has ornate upholstery, and there is a draped fabric in the background. The image is monochromatic.

artworks.title: Omar Pacha
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Hans P. Kraus, Jr.

artworks.title: Lichfield Cathedral from the North-West
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a Gothic cathedral's façade. The image shows an architectural structure with stone carvings, pointed arches, a large rose window, tall towers, spires, statues, and sculptural elements. A lamp post and railing are also visible in the foreground.

artworks.title: Fruit and Flowers
artworks.description: Grapes and flowers arranged on a tabletop in front of a dark background fill this horizontal photograph. The image is monochromatic like a black and white photograph but is printed in warm tones of golden and dark browns. The tabletop runs parallel and close to the bottom edge of the composition. It seems to be made of marble and a striped cloth folds over the front edge of the table to our left. Dark grapes are bunched around a vase at the middle of the composition. The vase's tall oval body and long, tapering neck are painted with decorative scrolls and curlicues. A few pieces of small round fruit, perhaps plums, rest on the table in front of the vase. A gleaming goblet to the left and a small figurine of a young boy with a sheaf of wheat to our right are almost lost in the profusion of roses, lilies, hyacinth, and other flowers that fill the space around and behind the objects. The top corners of the photograph are curved, creating a shallow arch.

artworks.title: Roger Fenton
artworks.artist: Roger Fenton or Dr. Hugh Welch Diamond
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated with his upper body visible. He is leaning slightly forward with clasped hands resting on a walking stick or cane. The man has a serious expression, with a full beard and mustache. His hair is neatly combed and can be seen under a cap. He is dressed in a suit with a vest, white shirt, and dark jacket. The background is plain and neutral, focusing on the subject without distractions.

artworks.title: Moscow, Domes of Churches in the Kremlin
artworks.description: The image shows a view looking down on a series of onion-shaped domes, a hallmark of Russian architecture. The largest domes are closest to the viewer, reflecting light to reveal their textured surfaces. The horizon is low with the domes receding towards a distant cityscape. More structures and smaller domes are visible in the distance. The color scheme is mainly sepia, creating a historic atmosphere. The scene contrasts bright highlights on the domes with softer, shadowed areas below, creating a play of light and shadow across the photograph.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene on a rainy day. The viewer's eye follows horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians into the distance. The horizon is high, defined by tall building rooftops blending into a cloudy sky. Brushstrokes create fine lines and crosshatches, reflecting a rain-soaked atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and muted browns. The wet pavement adds shine, creating a gradient. A cobblestone path leads to figures with umbrellas on the street. More buildings and figures are seen in the rain, creating depth in the urban landscape.

artworks.title: Westminster Palace
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, salt lift ground, and stippling in black and brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts the Palace of Westminster across a river. The horizon is low, defined by the river and building bases. The clock tower and other structures stand out. The etching shows detailed linework and shading of the Gothic architecture. The color palette is primarily shades of gray. Dark silhouettes of small boats are seen in the water. A decorative border surrounds the scene.

artworks.title: Westminster Palace
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, salt ground, and stippling with tonal wiping in black (main subject) and brown ink (margins) on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is an etching of the Palace of Westminster across the river. The view is from close to the riverbank looking towards the Parliament buildings under a mostly cloudy sky. The horizon is just above the waterline with the Palace of Westminster prominently displayed. The etching captures fine details, emphasizing the architecture's complex designs and textures. In the distance, dark outlines contrast with lighter parts of the sky. The color palette consists of sepia tones. The foreground shows a river scene with boats. The etching is surrounded by an ornate border with intricate patterns.

artworks.title: Westminster Bridge
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and aquatint with tonal wiping in black (main subject) and brown (margins) ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an urban scene with a clock tower resembling the Big Ben in the center. Surrounding the tower are historical buildings, people, horse-drawn carriages, and street lamps. The horizon features a bridge and buildings. The artwork uses brown and sepia tones and intricate details to create a texture. The composition is enclosed in a border with sketches of maritime and architectural elements. The color palette is predominantly brown, giving the image a classic and timeless appearance.

artworks.title: Matinée d'Hiver sur les Quais (Winter Morning on the Quays)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint, and sandpaper ground in brown ink on japanese paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts an urban scene from a street-level viewpoint. The cityscape, buildings, industrial chimneys releasing smoke, and people and horse-drawn carriages are shown in fine lines and cross-hatching, creating a textured appearance. The color palette is primarily gray and brown. The scene conveys a somber and muted atmosphere.

artworks.title: La Traversee (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, and soft-ground etching with graphite notations on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various scenes on a ship. The image consists of several detailed sketches depicting life aboard a vessel. The main section shows figures ascending a staircase under umbrellas, leading to an elevated platform with steam rising above. To the left, there is a blurred landscape with a figure and a dog. The lower sections contain smaller sketches: one of a group huddled together, and another resembling an interior scene with figures seated along benches. The overall composition provides a glimpse into life on a ship.

artworks.title: Le Peintre de Marine (The Marine Painter)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, sandpaper ground, and spit bite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a silhouette of a figure walking along a shore. The horizon is above the center, separating the dark sea and dramatic sky filled with swirling clouds and birds. The textured brushstrokes create movement and chaos. The palette is monochromatic with shades of black and gray, conveying a moody atmosphere. The water reflects the sky, blending into the dark shoreline shapes.
